independent_acceptance.source_claim_and_location: Theorem9.1 proof, printed5090-5092/PDF68-70. After(9.3), an arbitrary Omega_tilde containing J with mass lambda^-1 epsilon1^-4 is used to claim unconditional epsilon-rarity under the conditioned measure, although the preceding chessboard estimate contains J.
independent_acceptance.hypotheses_and_quantifiers: Lemma6.7(4), PDF51-52, permits k=K=l=L=1, R=[0,1]^2, the identity translation and the occupied-face event invariant under the two central reflections. The already constructed mu_(ver,0) is a periodic Gibbs measure, so Proposition3.8 applies. Fix epsilon1>0 and then take lambda sufficiently large; q<1, q>j and mu(V)>q all hold.
independent_acceptance.decisive_independent_check: Corollary4.5 gives ||V||<=lambda^-1/4 and ||V^c||<=1-c lambda^-1/2, hence Proposition3.8 gives mu(V)>=c lambda^-1/2. The feasible J with a tile at(0,0) and nearest side vacancies has 0<j<=lambda^-1 and is disjoint from V. At fixed finite fugacity, buffered separated boxes have two possible interiors with uniformly positive conditional probabilities, excluding atoms. Select B subset V with mu(B)=q-j. For the permitted Omega_tilde=J union B, mu_tilde(V)=1-j/q>=1-epsilon1^4>lambda^-1/4. The singleton rarity condition is therefore false within the stated Gibbs setting.
independent_acceptance.counterevidence_and_boundaries: This is a counterexample to the intermediate unconditional assertion, not to the offset estimate or to existence/classification of the four phases. Keeping J is essential because Theta is the whole lattice off J. The finite rational and configuration-enumeration outputs are retained corroboration; they were not rerun and are not substituted for the analytic infinite-volume argument.
independent_acceptance.severity_result: Major retained: the false normalization inference lies directly in(9.3)->(9.4)->(9.2)->(9.1), supplying Theorem9.1 and subsequent quantitative correlation conclusions. A core derivation error is established without alleging whole-paper failure.
independent_acceptance.repair_check: For n=|A|, the J-restricted bound is epsilon1^4 s^max(n-4,0)<=max(epsilon1,s)^n. For n<=4 use epsilon1^4<=epsilon1^n, and for n>=4 compare each factor with the maximum. A separate smaller conditioning parameter can absorb fixed roots/constants before the large-lambda choice; this local bound is verified, while the entire repaired quantitative hierarchy is not certified.

independent_acceptance.hypotheses_and_quantifiers: Choose the permitted even rectangle R_(2x2), M=1 dividing L, M<=max(K,L), and lambda sufficiently large for M<sqrt(lambda)/C. The event is global, and the original fully packed exterior is retained.
independent_acceptance.decisive_independent_check: At M=1 every center is forced to zero. This is incompatible with the packed exterior, giving Z1(Etilde1)=0. independent_acceptance.counterevidence_and_boundaries: The already even-length Proposition4.4 is not refuted. The failure belongs to the explanatory lower/sharpness construction, not Lemma4.6's upper bound.
